lines.en: Excuse me, how can I get to the train station?
Go straight, then turn left at the traffic light.
It takes about twenty minutes by bus.
Is there a metro station near here?
I'd like a ticket to Alexandria, please.
The train leaves at half past seven.
I missed my flight because of the traffic.
Could you take me to the airport, please?
The taxi driver knew a faster way.
I prefer to walk when the weather is nice.
